phase: Bug 4 -- Image option in Frame Styles: rotation-aware cover-fit in root Studio's Frame-fill pipeline (root Studio only; World Builder v2 unchanged)
milestone: The last remaining gap in BACKLOG.md's 'add image option in frame styles' item -- an invisible cover-fit under-coverage bug in renderer/slideRenderer.js when a Frame Variation's frameOrnamentImage OR frameImage OR border-image carried a nonzero rotation. Root cause: the three image-cover call sites all computed scale=max(rect.w/iw,rect.h/ih) against the axis-aligned rect, so a rotated image no longer covered the rect corners and exposed whatever was drawn beneath. Fix: a shared _rotationCoverScale(rectW,rectH,iw,ih,rotationDeg) helper computes the rotated rect's own AABB (w'=|w*cos|+|h*sin|, h'=|w*sin|+|h*cos|) and returns max(w'/iw,h'/ih) -- byte-identical to before for rotation=0 (Museum Gallery pixel-hash unchanged), correct at any rotation. Applied identically at mat/border/ornament image sites. World Builder v2 itself was untouched by this ship: the field, Adapter, compile step and Working View/Runtime Preview render were all already in place from prior sprints. Verified 24/24 via bug4_frame_ornament_image_verify.js at the original 700ms wait (fix is at the source, not a timing workaround). Regression: both goldenBuild.js suites PASS; feature1_frameimage_verify.js 18/18; manageframes_inline_rotation_verify2.js 16/16; verify_image_rotation.js 19/19; verify_rotation_publish_honored.js 10/10; verify_stretch_fit.js ALL PASS; verify_simplify_place_frame.js 57/57; verify_transparent_bg.js 8/8.
